hypothesis: A single fixed daily long selection of low BTC-residual-variance perpetuals may capture a defensive cross-sectional premium after realistic execution costs. It is not a return-rank, BTC-impulse, funding-shock or technical-breakout signal. Long market exposure and BTC beta must be disclosed; profitable returns alone are not an alpha claim.

selection_disclosure.prior_exposure: During metadata inspection, research_evidence/ledger/candidate_risk_register.v1.json exposed numerical summaries of prior families. Those fields were not used to choose this family, parameters, windows or gates; no prior-family outcome packet or raw market file was opened. The exposure is retained rather than represented as zero prior knowledge.
selection_disclosure.uniqueness_basis: Preregistration identity and strategies.py signal-function inventories contain no low-idiosyncratic-variance selection family. This is a bounded metadata check, not a claim of exhaustive economic independence.
selection_disclosure.search: One hypothesis, one long primary, no short variant, parameter grid, optimization, retuning, ranked hypothesis list or holdout rescue.

trial_accounting.rule: Append this primary and every control attempt; preserve all prior families, variants, spends, failures and incomplete runs. Family index 260 is not asserted to equal the total number of tested variants. Raw/bootstrap/Holm diagnostics cannot be called confirmatory familywise-error control.

stage_a_authority_proposal.rule: A new C260 protected receipt must authenticate these existing artifacts, exact content crossbindings, actual bounded source queries/pages and accepted implementation closure before any source-row or identity read. This proposal does not unlock causal-v4 or C257/C258/C259. No calendar-month-end substitute for actual page bounds; clip before economic parsing.

windows_half_open_utc.stage_order: Development veto precedes every forward read. Stage A cannot read or admit source windows intersecting the sealed holdout. The holdout remains locked behind an independently accepted v6 closure, fresh C260 one-spend Stage-B receipt and explicit root ruling; v5 never authorizes its rows.
windows_half_open_utc.reset: Every fold/capital resets cash, positions, rolling fit, ATR and drawdown diagnostics. Preserve global chronological forward closed-R and stitched marked-equity drawdown without carrying fold capital into sizing. No position, return or fit crosses folds. No admission whose scheduled exit is at or after the fold end.

signal.decision_schedule: 00:00 UTC daily; d is the completed-bar availability boundary, not Binance raw close d-1ms
signal.universe: Full effective PIT-v8 crypto.members in original artifact order, followed by exact frozen filter-v3 snapshot eligibility; BTCUSDT is an independent reference stream, never a tradable. No CORE20 truncation or current/survivor/backfill universe.
signal.fit: For each eligible symbol, require 721 contiguous closed prices wholly inside the fold. Compute 720 binary64 log returns r_t=log(close_t/close_(t-1h)), ending at d. Using math.fsum two-pass centered moments, fit y=alpha+beta*x where x is contemporaneous BTC return and y the symbol return. beta=fsum((x-mean_x)*(y-mean_y))/fsum((x-mean_x)^2); alpha=mean_y-beta*mean_x. Zero/nonfinite BTC sum of squares means no signal for the cohort. Score=math.fsum((y-alpha-beta*x)^2)/718. No return-direction, momentum, funding-sign or BTC-direction filter.
signal.ranking: Ascending finite nonnegative score; exact score ties by Unicode symbol order. Retain full ranks. At most one actual long admission per decision, walking same-side lower ranks past occupied or infeasible symbols without reranking or reallocating to another side.
signal.warmup: Fold-reset 720-return fit and Wilder ATR24; no entry until both are causally complete. Missing prior signal history is an explicit causal skip, never a future-availability filter. Record every decision, warmup, filter, occupied, cost, sizing and incomplete-data reason.
signal.entry: Fixed next hourly open at d+1h. Never inspect entry-bar high/low/close before admission; any eventual live dispatcher requires independently accepted latency/quote/provenance handling, not a backdated observation.

book_and_execution.stop: 2*WilderATR24 from completed decision bars, fixed at the accepted causal engine's adverse executable entry; exact inherited adverse tick rules.
book_and_execution.path: Reuse accepted causal PACK open_position/walk_bar/time_exit/funding semantics. Gap-open stop first, then target gap; due-open full exit before that bar's later range. On genuinely unresolved intrabar stop/target collision, frozen stop wins. No partials, breakeven, trailing, pyramids or adds.
book_and_execution.sizing: Current isolated marked equity = settled cash plus every remaining position's causal marked reference movement. Settle signed funding, fees, adverse slippage and impact exactly once in chronological phases. Earlier same-open costs reduce later admission equity. Floor quantities; no minimum upsize or clipping maxQty. Feasibility at entry/stop/target must satisfy actual side-correct price ticks, min/max quantity, step and minNotional. Conservative initial modeled risk includes stressed round-trip fees/slippage/impact.
book_and_execution.drawdown: Show per-fold and global stitched marked cash drawdown / (0.01*fold starting capital), and global chronological cumulative closed net-R drawdown (each closed net-R uses that admission's modeled initial risk). Economic risk gate uses the worse global value. Open exposure never disappears at cashflow phases.

costs.funding: Actual signed settlements at verified effective cadence and causal marks, never assumed zero or invented 8h cadence. Preserve entry/exit boundary ordering inherited from accepted causal execution.
costs.impact: Reuse accepted pure impact_drag: participation=quantity*reference/prior_24h_quote_volume; participation>0.01 is infeasible; bps=min(10,10*sqrt(participation/0.01)); charge quantity*reference*bps/10000 per fill. All volume is causally closed before that fill.
costs.missing_exposure: Any missing required open/bar/mark/funding/filter/actual source integrity after exposure retains the attempted trade, known costs and all known marks, then makes candidate DATA_INCOMPLETE. No favorable zero, synthetic close, survivor deletion or forward fill.

economic_gates.net_cash_and_net_r: strictly positive in development, forward aggregate and each forward fold
economic_gates.bootstrap: Circular seven-day blocks, 10000 resamples, NumPy Generator(PCG64(260)); no seed choice or repeated bootstrap selection.
economic_gates.concentration_formula: max(positive net contribution per symbol)/sum(positive net contributions per symbol); no positive denominator fails
economic_gates.stress_net_cash_and_net_r: strictly positive in full causal stressed replay with stressed costs/equity/admissions; no same-trade fiction

report_and_acceptance.required: Complete attempt/skip/pre-authority ledger, gross/net cash and R, all cost components, funding, holding time, per-symbol/fold/month/week/regime attribution, full canonical hourly equity including flat hours, BTC correlation/beta and benchmark/cash disclosure, capacity diagnostics and source-integrity failures. Explicitly disclose unavailable diagnostics. Never call long beta exposure alpha or an enabling artifact profitable.
report_and_acceptance.cash_control: No trading, no fees, zero net return; diagnostic only.
report_and_acceptance.btc_control: One unlevered BTCUSDT long from the first causally eligible entry open to the last source-authorized open strictly before fold end, same fill fees/slippage/impact and signed funding; no reallocations or optimization. Missing benchmark feasibility/authority is explicit incomplete diagnostic, never fabricated economics or primary rescue.
report_and_acceptance.regime: Reporting only: inherited fold-reset BTC 1h EMA200, first199 unclassified, seed=math.fsum(first200)/200, update=(2/201)*close+(199/201)*ema, ABOVE iff close>=ema else BELOW; gaps reset, missing/warmup UNCLASSIFIED. No regime entry filter or numeric regime-rescue gate.
report_and_acceptance.implementation_status: No C260 source loader, executable historical CLI, receipt verifier, single-use identity claim or PAPER adapter is installed by this proposal. Reuse the accepted causal PACK execution/book/report semantics and accepted impact primitive through a separately reviewed fixed adapter; do not relabel an old candidate or bypass its gates.
report_and_acceptance.before_real_reads: Root must accept exact proposal/implementation bytes, append the protected trial registry/count, bind exact checksum source/content/implementation/dependency pins and persistent candidate260 single-use identity, and issue the fixed development-only command. No arbitrary loader/tape-to-evidence seal oracle. Independent review and exact-head protected gates remain mandatory.
